title: Plan the first step
intro: Turn today's study goal into a concrete if-then plan: when and where you start, and the very first small thing you will do.

first_step.label: Then I will… (one small first action, under two minutes)
first_step.placeholder: e.g. open the lecture notes and read the first worked example

obstacle.label: Optional: what might get in the way?
obstacle.placeholder: e.g. I feel like checking my phone first

obstacle_response.label: If that happens, then I will…
obstacle_response.placeholder: e.g. put the phone in another room and start anyway

rehearsal.instruction: Read your plan to yourself twice, slowly, picturing the moment it happens.
rehearsal.confirm: I have repeated my plan twice
